integrity.computations: The independently structured deterministic checker passed 826 fixed-wavenumber comparisons, 681 full-optimum checks, 400 depth-order families, and six limiting-regime tests. Finite checks supplement but do not replace proof.
integrity.proof: A hyperbolic-cotangent identity and strict AM–GM equality fix the unique optimal allocation; a positive cotangent-mixture elasticity identity and negative variance derivative establish unique global wave optimum and sharp limits.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exact linear inviscid, incompressible two-layer Rayleigh–Taylor growth between rigid walls; neither viscosity nor nonlinear dynamics nor discrete horizontal modes is treated. The total geometric height, not fluid masses, is fixed. The 1990 source full text was inaccessible; its detailed publisher abstract and the 1996 author-accessible full paper informed the historical comparison.
title: Unique fastest-growing Rayleigh–Taylor wave with an optimally allocated two-fluid column
